symptom: `create export mapping … with message definition` wrote value/object members in SCRIPT order; mx check (11.12.1) then failed with CE5015 "The mapping does not align with the underlying schema anymore … The order of the schema elements under 'Orders/Order' does not match the schema." at Object mapping element 'Order'. Worse after `alter message definition … add member`, which appends the member after nested objects, so the required order is not guessable
cause: `buildExportMappingFromMessageDefinition` appended children in `def.Children` order; nothing related them to the definition node's `Children` order
insight: **Measure which mapping kinds are order-sensitive before widening the fix**: on 11.12.1 the reversed body fails ONLY for export-over-message-definition; the import twin over the same definition and both JSON-structure mappings (import and export) check 0 errors in either order — so sorting those would be churn with no error behind it. Sort by the definition node's index rather than rejecting: the definition fully determines the order, and an `add member` appended after a nested association is an order no author would write. Stable sort keeps duplicates as written. mx reported one CE5015 per mapping (at the root object) when both the root and a nested level were out of order; nested-only disorder was not measured, so the unit test pins the nested level explicitly. Revert proof: stubbing the sort brings back exactly 2 × CE5015 on the bug-test MDL; fixed build 0 errors
